answers.question: What does my plan look like over the next few months?
answers.text:
Your long-term plan runs from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, November 22, covering 12 weeks across 7 phases. You are currently in the Base phase, which starts Monday, August 31 and ends Sunday, September 13. The next phase begins Monday, September 14.

Phases:
- Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks). Establish the habit of an evening walk and a regular wind-down to support your sleep routine.
- Build: Monday, September 14 to Sunday, September 27 (2 weeks). Deepen the evening movement habit with steady, comfortable walks.
- Recovery: Monday, September 28 to Sunday, October 4 (1 week). Keep movement gentle and protect your sleep rhythm as your body adapts.
- Base: Monday, October 5 to Sunday, October 11 (1 week). Return to consistent evening walks and keep your bedtime routine stable.
- Build: Monday, October 12 to Sunday, October 18 (1 week). Use a slightly longer walk to build confidence in your movement habit.
- Recovery: Monday, October 19 to Sunday, October 25 (1 week). Prioritize relaxation and easy movement to safeguard your sleep quality.
- Maintain: Monday, October 26 to Sunday, November 22 (4 weeks). Keep your walk-and-wind-down rhythm steady as it becomes automatic.

Weekly breakdown:
- Week 1, starting Monday, August 31 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Establish the habit of an evening walk and a regular wind-down to support your sleep routine.
- Week 2, starting Monday, September 7 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Reinforce your walking rhythm on the days you have available and notice how it affects your sleep.
- Week 3, starting Monday, September 14 (Build): key session Easy (walk). Deepen the evening movement habit with steady, comfortable walks.
- Week 4, starting Monday, September 21 (Build): key session Recovery (yoga). Add a gentle yoga wind-down to your routine to improve relaxation before bed.
- Week 5, starting Monday, September 28 (Recovery): key session Recovery (walk). Keep movement gentle and protect your sleep rhythm as your body adapts.
- Week 6, starting Monday, October 5 (Base): key session Easy (walk). Return to consistent evening walks and keep your bedtime routine stable.
- Week 7, starting Monday, October 12 (Build): key session Long (walk). Use a slightly longer walk to build confidence in your movement habit.
- Week 8, starting Monday, October 19 (Recovery): key session Recovery (yoga). Prioritize relaxation and easy movement to safeguard your sleep quality.
- Week 9, starting Monday, October 26 (Maintain): key session Easy (walk). Keep your walk-and-wind-down rhythm steady as it becomes automatic.
- Week 10, starting Monday, November 2 (Maintain): key session Easy (walk). Protect the evening movement routine when life gets busy.
- Week 11, starting Monday, November 9 (Maintain): key session Technique (yoga). Refine the blend of walking and yoga that leaves you feeling most rested.
- Week 12, starting Monday, November 16 (Maintain): key session Easy (walk). Sustain your movement habit and consistent bedtime for the long term.
